lessons.title: First aid: CPR on a cushion and the recovery position
lessons.bigQuestion: Most cardiac arrests happen at home. If it happened in your home, would you know what to do?
objectives: To understand how to help an unresponsive casualty: check, call 999, CPR and the recovery position
successCriteria: All: describe the primary survey (danger, response, airway, breathing)
Most: demonstrate CPR rhythm and depth on a cushion
Some: explain when to use the recovery position and when to start CPR
lessons.crossCurricular: Science: the heart and circulatory system

keywords.def: cardiopulmonary resuscitation: chest compressions (and rescue breaths) to keep blood moving
automated external defibrillator: a device that can restart the heart
a safe position for an unresponsive person who is breathing
DRABC: danger, response, airway, breathing, call for help

hook.text: Most cardiac arrests happen at home. If it happened in your home, would you know what to do?
hook.a: Call 999, start CPR, get an AED. Bystander CPR can double the chance of survival.

islamicLink.text: Allah says: 'Whoever saves one life, it is as if he had saved mankind entirely' (al-Ma'idah 5:32). Learning first aid is a way to fulfil this.

starter.q: What does al-Ma'idah 5:32 say about saving a life?
starter.a: It is as if saving all mankind.

teach.heading: Primary survey
bullets: Breathing: look, listen, feel for up to 10 seconds
teach.note: If not breathing normally: call 999 on speaker and start CPR.

teach.heading: CPR (adult)
bullets: Centre of the chest, heel of hand
30 compressions : 2 rescue breaths, or hands-only CPR
teach.note: Practise on a firm cushion on the floor. Never practise compressions on a person.

head: Step
Detail
rows: Speaker on; send someone for an AED
Switch on and follow the voice

teach.heading: Recovery position
bullets: On their side, head tilted back
teach.note: Explain with a diagram; do not demonstrate on another person on camera.

teach.heading: Check
teach.note: Launch the poll.

check.q: An adult is unresponsive and not breathing normally. After calling 999 you should...
options: Put them in the recovery position
check.why: No normal breathing means CPR; the recovery position is for someone who is breathing.

practice.q: Practise 30 compressions on a cushion with the teacher's count (100 to 120 a minute).
practice.a: Rhythm kept at about two per second.
practice.model: Teacher demonstrates on a cushion, counting aloud.

independent.q: Core: Sequence cards (pupil PDF): put the steps for an unresponsive casualty in order and say what changes if they are breathing.
independent.a: Danger, response, airway, breathing, 999, CPR and AED; breathing: recovery position.
independent.model: Teacher places the first two cards.

independent.q: Extend: Find where the nearest public AED is to your home (with a parent, using The Circuit or a local map).
independent.a: A named AED location.

independent.q: Stretch: In the portal response box, explain why hands-only CPR is still worth doing. Start: 'Hands-only CPR...'
independent.a: Hands-only CPR keeps blood with oxygen moving to the brain until help arrives.

exit.q: CPR compression rate? A) 30 a minute B) 100 to 120 a minute C) 200 a minute
exit.a: B) 100 to 120 a minute

exit.q: Big question: if it happened at home, what would you do first?
exit.a: Check danger and response, call 999, start CPR, get an AED.

lessons.homework: Teach a family member the DRABC steps and the CPR rhythm on a cushion.
lessons.send: SEND: step cards with symbols. EAL: compress, breathe, airway. Stretch: research how an AED decides to shock.

lessons.title: Choking and severe bleeding
lessons.bigQuestion: Someone at the dinner table suddenly cannot speak or cough. What is happening and what will you do?
objectives: To understand how to help someone who is choking or bleeding severely until help arrives
successCriteria: All: tell mild from severe choking
Most: describe back blows and abdominal thrusts in the right order
Some: describe how to control severe bleeding with direct pressure and when to call 999
lessons.crossCurricular: Science: the respiratory system and blood clotting

keywords.def: a blocked airway
firm blows between the shoulder blades to clear a blockage
sharp inward and upward pulls above the navel
pressing firmly on a wound to slow bleeding

hook.text: Someone at the dinner table suddenly cannot speak or cough. What is happening and what will you do?
hook.a: Severe choking: up to 5 back blows, then up to 5 abdominal thrusts, call 999 if not cleared.

islamicLink.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Allah helps His servant as long as the servant helps his brother' (Muslim). Quick, calm action in an emergency is a way of serving others.

starter.q: When do you use the recovery position?

starter.a: A defibrillator that can restart the heart.

teach.heading: Mild or severe choking?
bullets: Severe: cannot cough, speak or breathe
teach.note: Do not slap the back of someone coughing well.

teach.heading: Severe choking (adult)
bullets: Up to 5 back blows between shoulder blades
teach.note: Explain with a diagram; do not practise thrusts on anyone.

teach.heading: Severe bleeding
bullets: Press firmly on the wound with a clean pad
Keep pressure; add more pads on top
Do not remove objects stuck in a wound
teach.note: Wear gloves if available.

model.problem: A deep cut to the forearm is bleeding heavily.
steps: Check danger; call 999 (or ask someone to)
Press firmly with a clean cloth
Keep pressing; add pads, do not lift to look
Watch for shock: pale, cold, fast breathing

teach.heading: Check
teach.note: Launch the poll.

check.q: A choking adult can still cough strongly. What should you do?
check.why: A strong cough is the best way to clear a mild blockage.

practice.q: Order: abdominal thrusts, encourage cough, back blows, call 999.
practice.a: Encourage cough, back blows, abdominal thrusts, call 999.
practice.model: Teacher orders the steps, explaining the reason for each.

independent.q: Core: Emergency scenarios (pupil PDF): choose the right first aid for four situations.
independent.a: Correct actions for choking and bleeding scenarios.

independent.q: Extend: Check your home first aid kit with a parent and list what is missing.
independent.a: A checked list.

independent.q: Stretch: In the portal response box, explain why you should not remove an object stuck in a wound.
independent.a: It may be plugging the wound; removing it can cause heavy bleeding.

exit.q: Severe choking: first action? A) give water B) up to 5 back blows C) wait
exit.a: B) up to 5 back blows

exit.q: Big question: someone at the table cannot speak or cough. What do you do?
exit.a: Back blows, then abdominal thrusts, call 999 if not cleared.

objectives: To understand British values, how communities stay united, and how to recognise and challenge extremism
successCriteria: All: name the four British values
Most: explain what extremism is and its warning signs
Some: explain how Islam's teaching of moderation rejects extremism
lessons.smsc: Social: citizenship, cohesion and the rule of law

keywords.def: democracy, rule of law, individual liberty, mutual respect and tolerance
people living together well
vocal or active opposition to British values, including calls for violence
the process of being drawn into extremism

hook.text: Why do extremist groups often target young people online?
hook.a: Young people may feel angry, lonely or unheard; extremists offer false belonging and simple answers.

islamicLink.text: Allah describes the Muslims as 'a just community' (Al-Baqarah 2:143) and says: 'whoever kills a soul unless for a soul or for corruption [done] in the land - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. And whoever saves one - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely.' (Al-Ma'idah 5:32). Islam forbids killing innocents and calls for balance.

head: Value
In daily life
rows: Freedom of belief and speech within the law

teach.heading: Warning signs of radicalisation
teach.note: Report concerns to the safeguarding lead (TO CONFIRM); Prevent duty applies to schools.

bullets: Killing one innocent is like killing all humanity (5:32)

teach.heading: Challenging extremist ideas
cycle: Check with reliable scholars and teachers

teach.heading: Quick check
teach.note: Launch the Teams poll; share the results and explain the right answer and why the others are wrong.

check.q: Which is a warning sign of radicalisation?
options: Secretive new online contacts who justify violence
check.why: Secrecy plus justifying violence are key warning signs.

practice.q: A post says 'Muslims can never be British.' How would you challenge it respectfully?
practice.a: Muslims are part of British society; Islam teaches respect and keeping agreements; the law protects religion or belief.
practice.model: I do: name the false claim, give facts (millions of British Muslims), Islamic teaching (5:8, keep covenants), and legal protection.

independent.q: Paragraph (portal response box): 'How can young British Muslims help build community cohesion?' Use one British value and one Islamic teaching. Start: 'Young British Muslims can ...'
independent.a: A paragraph with a value, a teaching and an example.
independent.model: The teacher writes the opening sentence.

independent.q: Extend: explain why extremist groups twist religious texts.
independent.a: To recruit by claiming false authority; context and scholarship expose the distortion.

exit.q: Concerns about radicalisation should be reported to ...
exit.a: the school safeguarding lead

exit.q: Back to our ponder: Why do extremist groups often target young people online?
exit.a: Young people may feel angry, lonely or unheard; extremists offer false belonging and simple answers.

lessons.title: Looking after friends

objectives: To understand how to notice when a friend is struggling during exam season and how to support them safely

Most: use good listening and signposting

hook.text: During exams everyone is stressed. How can you tell when a friend needs more than a pep talk?
hook.a: Lasting changes: not eating or sleeping, withdrawing, talking about giving up: these need an adult's help.

islamicLink.text: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself' (al-Bukhari and Muslim).
